description: Intent i007 (SNAPSHOT=s02, BRANCH=drm-userif-divisor) complete. One high-confidence finding: drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/swsmu/smu11/smu_v11_0.c lines 1196-1224, smu_v11_0_set_fan_speed_rpm, quote "tach_period = 60 * crystal_clock_freq * 10000 / (8 * speed);". Untrusted source: hwmon sysfs fan1_target store amdgpu_hwmon_set_fan1_target (amdgpu_pm.c:2845 kstrtou32, :2862 amdgpu_dpm_set_fan_speed_rpm) reachable by a local unprivileged user after manual fan mode; dispatch smu_set_fan_speed_rpm (amdgpu_smu.c:2725) rejects only U32_MAX, then navi10_ppt.c:3589 / sienna_cichlid_ppt.c:3199 forward the raw u32. Violated invariant: validation checks only the raw input (speed == 0 at smu_v11_0.c:1207) while the divisor actually used is 8 * speed in uint32_t, which wraps to 0 for speed > UINT_MAX/8. Unsafe use: wrapped-zero denominator of the tach-period division at line 1217 -> integer divide-by-zero kernel oops during CG_TACH_CTRL programming (same seed mechanism, unpatched smu11 variant; vega10_thermal.c:310, vega20_thermal.c:194, arcturus_ppt.c:1270, smu_v13_0.c:1229 all carry the UINT_MAX/8 bound in this snapshot, isolating smu11 as the gap). Twelve candidates classified: the finding plus its entry-point/dispatch links reported; smu7_thermal.c:280 safe (u8*100 firmware rpm bounds); radeon ci_dpm.c:1172 and si_dpm.c:6199 safe (#if 0 dead code, no fan1_target attr); smu7_hwmgr.c:5542 and vega10_hwmgr.c:5642 safe (scaled input_clk revalidated against firmware overdrive limits, never a divisor); smu_v13_0_0_ppt.c OD fan settings safe (firmware od_min/max checks); nouveau therm base.c:250 safe (clamped duty bounds). Limitations: source-reading verification only, no Navi10/Sienna-Cichlid hardware to trigger the wrap; other DRM ioctl surfaces (i915/msm/panfrost etc.) not individually audited; adjacent OOB-read at vega10_hwmgr.c:5374 noted but out of scope. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i007.json.
